Personal data

Information submitted through the contact and application forms is used by TMI only to answer your request or review your application. It is not passed on to third parties. Applications are kept for two years at most. You may request access to, correction or deletion of your data by writing to contact@tmi-caraibes.com.

The data controller is TMI, represented by its President. Messages sent through the forms are received by our hosting provider, Netlify, Inc., which may process them in the United States on our behalf before forwarding them to TMI by email. If you believe your rights are not respected, you may lodge a complaint with the French data protection authority, the CNIL (www.cnil.fr).

Cookies
